title: github_pat source-credential data block
description: The `data` block of a `github_pat` secret consumed by the plugin install system (req-tap-plugin-arch-source-secret). Distinct from the github_core collector's `repos`-bearing github_pat schema: a git credential scopes by HOST, not a repo list. Owned by the install system; validated in the settings-free pre-boot stage (tap/plugin_source_auth.py) via tap.runtime_secrets, never by tap_cares.

token.description: The GitHub personal access token. Fine-grained, Contents: Read-only, scoped to the plugin repos (req-tap-plugin-arch-source-least-priv). Fed to git via GIT_ASKPASS as the HTTPS password; NEVER interpolated into the source URL (it would leak into the venv's direct_url.json) (req-tap-plugin-arch-source-secret-4).

host.description: Git host this credential authenticates to. Default github.com; override for a GitHub Enterprise host. The credential helper matches by host, so one github_pat covers every repo on that host it is authorized for.

username.description: HTTPS username paired with the token. Default x-access-token, which works for both fine-grained/classic PATs and GitHub App installation tokens; GitHub ignores the username value for token auth but a non-empty one is required by the HTTPS credential exchange.
